changes: No substantive changes; added note on the Māgha/CE year conversion, the stray '4', and why 'svārthaṃ parārthaṃ ca' does not make the scribe the owner

notes: 'ghṛguvāsare' is a scribal corruption of bhṛguvāsare (Friday). 'jottirvidena' is a corruption of jyotirvidena; 'vireśvara' is read as Vīreśvara. The era is taken to be VS because the colophon says only 'saṃvat'. VS 1869 −57 gives 1812, but Māgha śukla 10 of that year falls in January/February 1813 CE. The '4' after 'svārthaṃ parārthaṃ ca' is unclear and may be a punctuation or filler mark. 'svārthaṃ parārthaṃ ca' is a stock formula, so the scribe is not also recorded as owner.
